purpose: Two passages per category that give different values. Neither is authoritative.

trial.note: No trial wording in this document.

passages.quote: Your subscription renews automatically every month on your billing date.
Subscriptions automatically renew for a further term of one year.
The price of PixelForge Pro is $15.00 per month.
The annual fee is $150.00 per year, billed in advance.
passages.note: Annual fee. Different amount and interval from Section 3.

passages.quote: To cancel, give us at least 7 days' notice before your renewal date through the Billing page.
You must give at least 30 days' written notice to cancel your subscription.
passages.note: 30 days written notice. Differs from Section 4.

passages.quote: If you are not satisfied, you may request a full refund within 14 days of purchase.
passages.note: Refund within 14 days. Differs from Section 5.
